# tt-mlir D2M known regression failures against tt-emule.
#
# Format: one pytest node-id per line, e.g.
#   test_metal_reductions.py::test_reduce_dim_NN
# Wildcards via fnmatch (* and ?) are supported, e.g.
#   test_metal_reductions.py::test_reduce_unaligned_*
#
# The CI classifier (`classify-d2m-results.py`) fails the job on any of:
#   - a test that failed in CI and is NOT covered by an entry here
#   - an entry that matches a test which now PASSES (remove the entry)
#   - an entry that matches no test (stale — update the file)
#

# run reports the observed failures, paste them here in a follow-up commit.
